final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt. The yen receipt test passes now, and so do the other 17 tests.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and always showed two decimals, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a small `ZERO_DECIMAL` set (just `JPY` for now). Currencies in it are shown as whole amounts.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoices and the cart will also show yen correctly now. Nothing else in the repo uses yen, and no test relied on the old output.
